hhem_2_1_open.architecture: FLAN-T5-base encoder with a two-class token-classification head
hhem_2_1_open.score_direction: Higher softmax class-1 score means more consistent/supported.
hhem_2_1_open.execution_route: Direct official-demo-equivalent CPU architecture loading; no trust_remote_code execution.

minicheck_flan_t5_large.architecture: FLAN-T5-Large sequence-to-sequence model scored on the first decoder token
minicheck_flan_t5_large.score_direction: Higher probability for token ID 209 versus token ID 3 means more support.
minicheck_flan_t5_large.execution_route: Pinned checkpoint loaded on CPU; direct single-packet scoring equivalent to the pinned reference code.
